items.title: Sharkey Bonano Interview, 1966-11-09
items.q: Sherwood and, wait they have another one.

ctx.x: Not very many people played the bass or those, I noticed when you were showing how Chink or different people would play the bass you'd do it left handed too. I guess Sherwood's the only left handed bass player I know.
Yeah. Sherwood and, wait they have another one. Is there another one there? I think there's another fella plays with Doth Angels.
I don't know his name but he plays left handed too. Maybe I've seen him in and forgot about it.
